title: Motor accident compensation is a statutory welfare-oriented regime under the Motor Vehicles Act 1988

content.overview: Motor accident compensation is a statutory welfare-oriented regime under the Motor Vehicles Act 1988. MACT proceedings focus on just compensation, statutory liability and structured assessment of dependency, disability and other heads.
content.study:
Motor accident compensation is a statutory welfare-oriented regime under the Motor Vehicles Act 1988. MACT proceedings focus on just compensation, statutory liability and structured assessment of dependency, disability and other heads.\
\
The Motor Vehicles Act creates a specialised compensation system distinct from ordinary tort litigation. Sarla Verma standardised multiplier methodology; Pranay Sethi addressed future prospects and conventional heads. Later decisions continue to refine these principles.
